prompt_en: Create a photographic beauty editorial of one adult woman in a rain-streaked rooftop studio at dusk, using the attached portrait as the appearance reference. Preserve the visible reference features: long dark center-parted wavy hair, brown eyes, oval face, softly arched brows, a slender straight nose, and the natural shape of her lips. Her face, makeup, skin, and hair are the visual center of the photograph. Copper metallic pigment covers both upper eyelids in a smooth reflective sweep, while a precise plum stain defines the lips. Real skin retains fine pores and soft tonal variation beneath the luminous makeup. Her hair falls in distinct broad waves over both shoulders, with individual strands visible at the edges. She stands behind a waist-high stone counter, both forearms resting parallel on its top; her relaxed hands lie separately on the stone with fingers softly curved, wrists connected naturally to the forearms. Her upright torso supports a slight forward lean toward the camera. She looks directly into the lens with a calm, poised expression. A black open-collar blouse frames the neck. A large diffused overhead light reveals the eyelid shimmer and cheek texture, while a pink background glow illuminates the rain-streaked windows behind her. Frame a vertical waist-up portrait with the entire face, both hair silhouettes, and both resting hands visible; the counter crosses the lower foreground. Keep the background softly out of focus while the eyes and copper eyelids remain crisp. Use an 85mm portrait lens at eye level, with enough depth of field to keep the resting hands legible. A white reflector below the face lifts the eye sockets while retaining gentle shadows beside the nose. In this composition, the requested makeup design appears on its specified facial region; the crop and focus resolve that design at useful scale; adjacent skin and facial landmarks remain distinguishable.
